patterns.structure: As is shown in the chart/picture, ...
patterns.meaning: 第一段开头：描述图表或图画
examples: As is shown in the chart, the ownership of three types of household appliances increased from 2014 to 2023.
As is shown in the picture, several residents are resting and exercising in a newly built park.

patterns.structure: The chart shows that + 完整句子
patterns.meaning: 说明图表呈现的数据变化
examples: The chart shows that the number of parks in the city increased continuously from 2020 to 2022.

patterns.meaning: 概括图表趋势、图画寓意或段落观点
examples: Overall, all three types of household appliances showed an upward trend, which reflects an improvement in people’s living conditions.
In general, this picture shows that traditional customs are becoming more and more popular.

patterns.structure: On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...
patterns.meaning: 从两个方面分析原因、影响或意义
examples: On the one hand, population aging has increased the demand for elderly care.
On the other hand, advances in technology have made these robots more intelligent and convenient.

patterns.structure: It is beneficial to do A and do B.
examples: It is beneficial to broaden our horizons and enrich our knowledge.

patterns.structure: It is significant that + 完整句子
patterns.meaning: 强调某种现象或行为的重要意义
patterns.position: 第一段总结或第二段总起
examples: In general, it is significant that the dragon boat race has become more popular.
All things considered, it is significant that we take part in lectures in different fields.

patterns.structure: A not only does B but also does C.
patterns.meaning: 并列说明两种作用或结果
examples: This change not only improves the urban environment but also increases residents’ sense of happiness.
The activity of traditional customs not only enriches people’s lives but also promotes the development of traditional culture.

patterns.meaning: 补充说明前面的情况或结果
patterns.position: 第一段总结或第二段分析
examples: People may still worry about safety, privacy, and price, which directly influence their willingness to use such products.

patterns.structure: whether + 完整句子 + or not
examples: Students should not just pay attention to whether a lecture is beneficial to their majors or not.

patterns.structure: Only when + 完整句子 + can + 主语 + 动词原形
patterns.meaning: 第三段结尾：强调共同努力或必要条件
examples: Only when manufacturers, the government, and consumers work together can elderly-care robots play a greater role in society.
Only when the government and residents work together can urban parks play a greater role and bring more benefits to individuals, families, and society.

patterns.structure: 主语 + can + 动词 ... only when + 完整句子

patterns.structure: A provides B with chances/places for C.
